job: See how values change over time or between periods.
purpose: An SVG line, area, bar or stacked bar chart from a JSON config: labels, up to six series, an optional threshold. Hairline grid, mono axes, the first series in the accent. Lines draw in once on scroll. A crosshair and tooltip follow the pointer, a finger or the arrow keys. Every chart has role="img" and a hidden data table.
useWhen: A value moves continuously over time: use line, or area for volume.
Discrete periods are compared: use bar, or stacked for a total and its parts.
A number has a limit: draw a labelled threshold on the chart.
A live series should end in a pulsing dot.

avoidWhen.when: A direction beside a figure, without axes.
Parts of a whole with two to five segments.
Exact values to compare across many columns.

states.name: loading
states.how: data-state="loading" on an element with no data; keeps the height

states.name: empty
states.how: data-state="empty" says so and suggests what to change

states.name: live
states.how: a series with live set ends in a pulsing dot

states.name: gap
states.how: a null value is a gap, not a zero

variants.useWhen: A value whose volume matters as well as its shape.
Discrete periods, grouped side by side.
A total and its parts; the tooltip adds a Total row.
A solid grid for print or dense charts.
A series that carries meaning, such as failures.
A stat delta that is good.
A stat delta that is bad.

parts.role: The chart; data-fd-chart names the type.
A card that holds a chart with a title and a legend.
